title: Settings
themeHint: Light, dark or as on the device. Saved to your account.
languageHint: The language of the interface, dates and amounts. Saved to your account.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.hint: Amounts on screen are replaced with dots. Applies to this device only.

myName.title: Your name
myName.label: Name in this space
myName.hint: Other members see it. Without a name, the start of your email is shown.

space.title: Space
space.ownerOnly: Only the owner can change the space's name, currency and time zone.
space.name: Name
space.baseCurrencyHint: Totals are counted in it. It can be changed only while the space has no operations.
space.baseCurrencyLocked: The base currency can no longer change: the space's operations are already converted to it, and totals would mix two currencies.
space.timeZoneHint: It decides what «today», the end of the month and a payment date are.
space.nextIncomeHint: «Available» is counted up to this date. Without a date the amount is not calculated.
space.nameRequired: Enter a name, up to 60 characters

access.ownerIntro: Who sees the space «{space}» and what they can change. Access can be revoked at any time.
access.memberIntro: You can see the members of the space «{space}», but you cannot change them.
access.notice: Your role in the space «{space}» is «{role}». Only the owner, {owner}, can invite people and change roles.

roleHints.owner: Everything an editor can, plus invites people, changes roles, revokes access and deletes the space.
roleHints.editor: Enters operations, marks payments, changes categories and plans. Sees who entered what.
roleHints.viewer: Sees the space's accounts, operations and payments, changes nothing.

inviteSheet.title: Invite someone to «{space}»
inviteSheet.emailHint: The link is valid for 7 days and works once. Send it to the person yourself.
inviteSheet.roleNote: You can change the role or revoke access at any time.
inviteSheet.doneHint: It is shown once and stored nowhere. Copy it and send it to the person: they open it with this address.
inviteSheet.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the link and copy it by hand

revokeSheet.title: Revoke {name}'s access?
revokeSheet.body: {name} will no longer see the space «{space}» and cannot enter operations. Everything already entered stays, marked as entered by {name}.
revokeSheet.again: You can invite {name} again at any time.

cancelSheet.title: Cancel the invite for {email}?
cancelSheet.body: The link will stop working. You can invite the person again at any time.

leaveSheet.title: Leave the space «{space}»?
leaveSheet.body: You will no longer see this space's accounts and operations. What you entered stays. You can return only with a new invite from {owner}.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.label: Reminders of this space for me
reminders.hint: Your own choice only: other members get reminders by their own settings. When off, none arrive in the app or as push.

data.exportHint: Files with the data of the active space. Any member can export.
data.deleteHint: Operations, accounts, payments, debts and receipts of the space are deleted for good. The space and its members stay.
data.deleteBody: This cannot be undone. If you may need the data, save the archive first.
data.typeName: To confirm, type the space name «{space}»
